skill.summary: Verify email addresses using the BillionVerify API. Use when user wants to verify single emails, batch verify email lists, upload files for bulk verification...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the BillionVerify API skill.

- Verify single emails or batch email lists via the BillionVerify API.
- Upload files for bulk email verification; track status and download results.
- Check credit balance directly from the skill.
- Create, list, and delete webhooks for real-time notifications.
- Includes rate limits and credit usage details for efficient management.
